title: Onboard Win2 (DESKTOP-9BFCGFI) as a federation satellite test runner and dispatch suitable gates to it
outcome: Win2 is an Active, verified federation satellite of the central host, and suitable merge-ready gates run there under the test-ref rule, reducing test contention on the central host without displacing the A↔Mac mailbox/S3 priority.
acceptance: An onboarding packet lists Greg's operator acts for Win2 (binary and build hash, settings, credential placement on both hosts) and the agents' steps 1-7 of docs/features/satellite-onboarding.md, and it is sent to Greg through Engram::Advisor.
Win2 reaches Verified through an explicit verification report with every TermAl check passed, and is activated by the operator action; the report is recorded on this item.
At least one merge-ready full gate runs on Win2 under the test-ref rule, and its evidence is returned and recorded, with no displacement of the A↔Mac S3 work.
